wonder.en: Moving to Europe, the Colosseum in Rome was also voted as a new wonder.
wonder.zh: 来到欧洲，罗马斗兽场也被投票选为新奇迹。

wonder.en: These places were considered wonders because of their size or their beauty or their engineering.
wonder.zh: 这些地方之所以被认为是奇迹，是因为它们的规模、美感或工程技术。

wonder.en: Now, you might be wondering: how do we know this " self-domestication " actually happened?
wonder.zh: 现在，你可能会好奇：我们怎么知道这种“自我驯化”真的发生过呢？

wonder.en: There’s a lot to get through, so no wonder it took him so long!”
wonder.zh: 有太多内容要讲了，难怪他花了这么长时间！”

wonder.en: So, I’m wondering, do you do things that you think are good for the planet?
wonder.zh: 那么，我在想，你会做一些你认为对地球有益的事情吗？

workshop.en: Project worker Anamarija Sočo leads workshops encouraging dads and sons to take some of the pressure off mums.
workshop.zh: 项目工作人员安娜玛丽亚·索科领导了旨在鼓励爸爸和儿子为妈妈们分担压力的工作坊。

workshop.en: In Verrocchio’s workshop (a workshop being the place where art and crafts are created), Leonardo studied various different things.
workshop.zh: 在韦罗基奥的工作室（工作室是创作艺术和工艺品的地方），列奥纳多学习了各种不同的东西。

workshop.en: In Verrocchio’s workshop (a workshop being the place where art and crafts are created), Leonardo studied various different things.
workshop.zh: 在韦罗基奥的工作室（工作室是创作艺术和工艺品的地方），列奥纳多学习了各种不同的东西。

worst.en: The worst-case scenario is the worst possible thing that could happen in a particular situation.
worst.zh: 最坏情况（worst-case scenario）是指在特定情况下可能发生的最糟糕的事情。

worst.en: A worst-case scenario is the worst possible thing that could happen in a particular situation.
worst.zh: “最坏情况”（worst-case scenario）是指在特定情况下可能发生的最糟糕的事情。

worst.en: "I have made the worst mistake of my life," the young man said, almost weeping.
worst.zh: "我犯下了此生最严重的错误，"这个年轻人几乎带着哭腔说道。

worst.en: When the girls started twitching and shouting, the village was ready to believe the worst.
worst.zh: 当女孩们开始抽搐和尖叫时，全村人已经准备好往最坏的方向去想了。

worst.en: So, Phil, what's the worst thing someone can do while eating, in your opinion?
worst.zh: 那么 Phil，在你看来，一个人在吃饭时能做的最糟糕的事情是什么？

worse.en: To make matters worse, the Germans changed the settings every single night at midnight.
worse.zh: 更糟糕的是，德国人每天午夜都会准时更改设置。

worse.en: And worse, it makes science a turn-off – something that people dislike or find uninteresting.
worse.zh: 更糟糕的是，它让科学变得令人扫兴——人们不喜欢或觉得无趣的东西。

worse.en: However, the actual work they do is similar to or worse than every other employee.
worse.zh: 然而，他们实际做的工作与其他员工相似甚至更糟。

worse.en: The situation for the Nazi war machine was getting worse by the day.
worse.zh: 纳粹战争机器的局势一天比一天糟糕。

worse.en: From the outside, the capital looked modern and prosperous, but inequality and poverty grew worse.
worse.zh: 从表面上看，首都显得现代而繁荣，但财富不均和贫困却在恶化。

wolf.en: Dogs have a tiny muscle above their eyes that wolves simply do not have.
wolf.zh: 狗的眼睛上方有一块微小的肌肉，而狼身上根本没有这块肌肉。

wolf.en: But Maryanne Wolf, author of the book Reader Come Home, says that this isn't true.
wolf.zh: 但《阅读，回到祖国吧》（Reader Come Home）一书的作者玛丽安娜·沃尔夫（Maryanne Wolf）表示，事实并非如此。

wolf.en: Instead, the true story of how some wolves became dogs is likely one of self-domestication.
wolf.zh: 相反，一些狼变成狗的真实故事，很可能是自我驯化的结果。

wolf.en: Indeed, von Stauffenberg had only arrived at the Wolf’s Lair that morning.
wolf.zh: 事实上，冯·施陶芬贝格那天早上才刚抵达“狼穴”。

wolf.en: It's hardly surprising people called him “the wolf of the Indian Ocean”.
wolf.zh: 难怪人们称他为“印度洋之狼”。

wood.en: Adventure playgrounds have lots of small dangers: hard pieces of wood, sharp metal, nails.
wood.zh: 冒险游乐场有很多小危险：硬木头、尖锐的金属、钉子。

wood.en: None of the original wood remained. And this created a puzzle or a paradox.
wood.zh: 原来的木头一点也没有剩下。这就产生了一个谜题或悖论。

wood.en: It was wood, for the most part. Sometimes dried grass, peat, charcoal, or animal dung.
wood.zh: 大部分是木头。有时是干草、泥炭、木炭或动物粪便。

wood.en: Let's listen to Dietitian Claire Thornton Wood explaining on the BBC World Service programme, The Food Chain.
wood.zh: 让我们听听营养师克莱尔·桑顿·伍德（Claire Thornton Wood）在BBC世界广播公司节目《食物链》中的解释。

wood.en: But there wasn't an alternative; England was running out of trees, it was running out of wood.
wood.zh: 但别无选择；英格兰的树木快要砍光了，木头快要用完了。

wooden.en: As the wooden planks began to rot or break, they replaced them one by one.
wooden.zh: 随着木板开始腐烂或破裂，他们一块一块地更换它们。

wooden.en: On the Pacific Coast, some communities relied on fishing and built wooden longhouses.
wooden.zh: 在太平洋海岸，一些社群依靠捕鱼为生，并建造了木制长屋。

wooden.en: Well, a typical sauna is a small wooden room heated with steam to around 80°C.
wooden.zh: 嗯，典型的桑拿房是一个用蒸汽加热到 80°C 左右的小木屋。

wooden.en: Remember how the Athenians repaired the ship by replacing the old wooden parts with new ones.
wooden.zh: 还记得雅典人是如何通过用新木质零件替换旧木质零件来修理这艘船的吗？

wooden.en: There are stacks of used wooden pallets and big reels for holding wires.
wooden.zh: 这里有一堆堆用过的木托盘和用来装电线的巨大卷轴。

wonderful.en: It's wonderful. The first speaker says saunas make her feel at ease – a phrase meaning comfortable and relaxed.
wonderful.zh: 太棒了。第一位发言者说桑拿让她感到“at ease”——这个短语的意思是舒适和放松。

wonderful.en: OK, then, that is it for today's episode on the weird and wacky, and sometimes wonderful, world of British politics.
wonderful.zh: 好了，今天的节目就到这里，我们探讨了英国政治这个古怪、滑稽有时又美妙的世界。

wonderful.en: And what I find fascinating about ramen, compared to perhaps other wonderful noodle dishes around the world, is that ramen continues to evolve.
wonderful.zh: 我觉得拉面最迷人的地方在于，与世界上其他美妙的面条相比，拉面一直在不断演变。

wonderful.en: I’m not going to talk about a person’s life, a historical event, or some other weird and wonderful thing going on in the world.
wonderful.zh: 我不打算讲某个人的生平、历史事件，或者世界上正在发生的其他奇妙有趣的事情。

wonderful.en: What I do pay attention to, however, is what you, the wonderful listeners of this show and members of Leonardo English, tell me.
wonderful.zh: 然而，我关注的是你们，也就是本节目的优秀听众和 Leonardo English 的会员们告诉我的反馈。

worthy.en: If you take someone seriously, you consider them important and worthy of your attention.
worthy.zh: 如果你认真对待某人（take someone seriously），你会认为他们很重要且值得你关注。

worthy.en: Theseus wanted to prove that he was brave and worthy of being king.
worthy.zh: 忒修斯想证明自己是勇敢的，并且配得上做国王。

worthy.en: To some, this is a worthy achievement, a law that protects workers from exploitation at the hands of greedy corporations.
worthy.zh: 对某些人来说，这是一项了不起的成就，是一部保护工人免受贪婪公司剥削的法律。

worthy.en: There are only really three things that need to be true for me to decide that they are worthy of an episode.
worthy.zh: 只有满足三个条件，我才会决定某个主题值得做成一期节目。

wound.en: A shot is fired. Abdallah is dead, while Denard is wounded in the hand.
wound.zh: 枪声响起。Ahmed Abdallah 身亡，而 Bob Denard 的手部受伤。

wound.en: Clockwork machinery uses metal springs and wheels which move when they are wound up with a key.
wound.zh: clockwork machinery（发条机械）使用的是金属弹簧和轮子，用钥匙上发条时它们就会运动。

wound.en: Three men are dead on the ground. Three others are wounded.
wound.zh: 三人倒在地上死去，另外三人受了伤。

wound.en: On the other side, Virgil and Morgan Earp were both wounded.
wound.zh: 另一方，Virgil 和 Morgan Earp 都受了伤。

wound.en: What the loss of America did, undeniably, was wound him.
wound.zh: 美洲的丧失，无可否认地伤害了他。

woe.en: Now, Bob Denard is not responsible for all of the woes of the Comoros Islands.
woe.zh: 当然，Bob Denard 并不对科摩罗群岛所有的苦难负全部责任。

woe.en: It is imperfect, but to quote the two-time British Prime Minister, Winston Churchill, “Many forms of Government have been tried, and will be tried in this world of sin and woe.
woe.zh: 它并不完美，但正如两任英国首相温斯顿·邱吉尔所说：“在这个充满罪恶和悲伤的世界里，人们已经尝试过并且将继续尝试各种形式的政府。

worship.en: Previous and subsequent emperors became deified after death, but Caligula demanded worship in his own lifetime.
worship.zh: 前任和后来的皇帝都是在死后才被奉为神明，但 Caligula 要求在世时就受到崇拜。

worship.en: These were as wide-ranging as spitting on the cross, worshipping idols, homosexual practices, and financial impropriety.
worship.zh: 这些指控五花八门，从向十字架吐口水、崇拜偶像、同性恋行为，到财务违规。

worship.en: Rituals, ancestor worship, respect for hierarchy, and the idea that rulers governed with the approval of the gods were all central ideas in Ancient China.
worship.zh: 仪式、祖先崇拜、对等级制度的尊重，以及统治者凭借神明批准进行统治的观念，都是中国古代的核心思想。

worship.en: The settlers and the displaced native Irish lived side by side, but they worshipped in different churches, spoke different languages, and saw both the land and its future in completely different ways: for the settlers, it had been lawfully granted by the Crown; for the native Irish, it had been taken from them.
worship.zh: 定居者和流离失所的爱尔兰本地人并肩生活，但他们在不同的教堂礼拜，说不同的语言，对土地及其未来的看法也完全不同：对定居者来说，这是王室合法授予的；对本地爱尔兰人来说，这是从他们手中夺走的。

worm.en: They would be consumed by flesh-eating maggots or larvae, they would be blinded by little worms, there were all manner of diseases and threats that killed or crippled his travelling companions.
worm.zh: 他们会被食肉蛆虫或幼虫侵蚀，会被小虫子弄瞎双眼，有各种各样的疾病和威胁杀死了或致残了他的同伴。

worthwhile.en: It is proof that my effort was worthwhile.
worthwhile.zh: 这是证明我的付出是值得的证据。

worthless.en: The country suffered from hyperinflation, which is when money becomes basically worthless.
worthless.zh: 这个国家遭受了恶性通货膨胀，也就是钱基本上变得一文不值的时期。

worthless.en: There are numerous famous stories about how German people needed to pile a wheelbarrow full of cash and take it down to the shop just to buy bread because money had become worthless.
worthless.zh: 有许多著名的故事讲述了德国人如何需要把一独轮车现金推到商店去买面包，因为钱已经变得毫无价值。
